clues.title: Google car: pickup truck, cab and bed visible
text: A **visible Street View car **is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible. The colour of the cab and other features of it varies. In Generation 3, a **roof rack** is present. You may also find a large blur covering the entire pickup truck.
clues.summary: Most coverage shows a pickup truck with its cab and bed in view. Cab colour varies. Gen 3 has a roof rack, and sometimes the whole truck is hidden by one big blur.

clues.title: Google car: police car following behind
text: A **police car**, most commonly white or black, can almost always be seen following the Street View car. The follow cars may differ slightly from the ones shown in the image.
clues.summary: A white or black police car almost always follows the Street View car and shows behind it. It can occasionally be missing, so don't rule the country out if you don't see it.

clues.title: Plate: short, greenish through blur
text: Nigeria uses short licence plates that appear somewhat **green** through the blur.
clues.summary: Short plates that look somewhat green through the blur. A useful hint when the police car is not visible.

clues.title: Pole: concrete with dents and cross supports
text: Most Nigerian poles are made of concrete, have **indents **with a few **horizontal supports**, and are similar to the ones used in Brazil, but do not have holes through them.
clues.summary: Mostly concrete poles with indents and a few horizontal supports. They look like Brazil's, but have no holes through them.

differs.how: Brazilian poles have holes through them

clues.title: Road: no lines, potholes, unpaved roads
text: Roads are not always well-maintained in Nigeria, so roads **without roadlines **or faded roads are common. Potholes, cracked roads and unpaved roads are also relatively common.
clues.summary: Roads are often poorly kept: no road lines or faded ones are common, as are potholes, cracks and unpaved roads.

clues.title: Houses: single-storey, steep metal roofs
text: Most Nigerian houses are **single-storey**, with **steeply pitched roofs** commonly made of metal sheets. Cinder block walls surrounding the houses are also common.
clues.summary: Mostly one-floor houses with steep roofs, usually metal sheets, and cinder block walls around the yard.

clues.title: Signs: place names on shops and banners
text: **City and state names **are often found on storefronts or banners in Nigeria, so knowing them can be quite useful.
clues.summary: City and state names often appear on storefronts and banners, so knowing them helps.

clues.title: Coverage: very low quality, blocky blur
text: Within mainland Africa, Nigeria is currently the only country to have this **low-quality coverage**, known as official ari**, **or “shitcam”.

NOTE: Low quality coverage taken between 2023 and 2025 has especially [low quality](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FRmNSTEtGszBkRqEA). Often you can see huge cars through the blur, and this extremely low quality only appears elsewhere in Lebanon.
clues.summary: The only mainland African country with this very low-quality coverage. Coverage from 2023 to 2025 is even worse, with huge cars barely visible through the blur. That level appears elsewhere only in Lebanon.

clues.title: Landscape: flat, hills in a few areas
text: Nigeria is generally a **fairly flat **country with subtle elevation changes throughout. The south is relatively flat apart from some noticeable hills in the southeast, in Enugu state and in the southwest, between Ife and Lokoja. In the north, more prominent hills and mountains are found from Abuja and Jimeta. The largest mountains are found in the east, making up the Mandara mountain range and the Nigeria-Cameroon border. However, due to little coverage, the mountains are rarely visible.
clues.summary: Mostly flat with subtle changes. The south has a few hills in the south-east and south-west, and the north has bigger hills and mountains. The biggest mountains are in the east but are rarely visible.

clues.title: Plants: rainforest south to dry steppe north
text: Shown is a **Köppen climate map** of Nigeria. The climate ranges from tropical rainforest in the [far south](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvLGJLnQZK4qnzn99), where you can find an abundance of palms with lush, green vegetation, to a more arid, [savannah landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SZQcHSZAonH1A9RD6) in the centre, with more scattered trees. In the far north, it transitions to an [arid steppe](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeiAA6fxzbj3gae47) where the vegetation becomes even more sparse.
NOTE: Due to dry/wet seasons, the coverage may look drastically greener/drier than expected for certain latitudes.
clues.summary: Climate runs from tropical rainforest with lots of palms in the far south, to savannah with scattered trees in the centre, to dry steppe in the far north. Wet and dry seasons can make coverage greener or drier than expected.

clues.title: Coverage: sparse, mainly cities and highways
text: Nigeria is a **sparsely covered** country, with very few roads in the northwest and east. Most of the coverage is centred around big cities and the highways that connect them.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Coverage is sparse, with very few roads in the north-west and east. Most of it is around big cities and the highways between them.

clues.title: Google car: Gen 3 only south of the capital
text: Knowing where you can find each generation is very useful. Notably, Generation 3 is not found north of Abuja.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Knowing where each camera generation exists helps. Gen 3 is not found north of the capital Abuja.

clues.title: Google car: no Gen 4 in north-west or far south
text: Generation 4 is not found in the northwest or far south. Shitcam is now found in most of Nigeria.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Gen 4 is not found in the north-west or the far south. The very low-quality camera now covers most of the country.

clues.title: Vehicles: tuk tuk colour depends on state
text: This map shows states with **unique **vehicle and tuk tuk **colours**. If a vehicle is shown, the state will have yellow tuk tuks.
NOTE: There may be some rare exceptions to what is shown in the image. Paint jobs in-game may also differ slightly to those shown in the image.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._

images.caption: Tuk tuk colours by state, shown as photos linked to a map

clues.summary: Some states have their own vehicle and tuk tuk colours. The map shows which states have yellow tuk tuks. Rare exceptions exist, and in-game paint can look slightly different.

clues.title: Religion: Christian south, Muslim north
text: Nigeria is mainly **Christian **in the south, and **Islamic **in the north. As such, seeing women in hijabs and men in Muslim attire is more common in the north.

images.caption: Mosque and Muslim dress in the green north, churches in the red south, with a map between them

clues.summary: Mainly Christian in the south and Muslim in the north, so women in hijabs and men in Muslim dress are more common in the north.

clues.title: Farming: haystacks, in one northern state
text: These **haystacks** are extremely common and are almost exclusively found in Kaduna state.
clues.summary: Very common haystacks, almost only seen in one northern state.

clues.title: Landscape: dry green farmland with corn
text: If you find yourself in an **arid**, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of **corn **around, you are likely to be in Kano state. It is only covered by shitcam, without any Generation 3 or 4.
clues.summary: A dry but green farming landscape with lots of corn points to one northern state, which only has the very low-quality camera, no Gen 3 or 4.

clues.title: Landscape: lush grass, red soil, thatched huts
text: Benue state can be recognized by the lush, green **grass covered ground**, with **reddish soil**. The vegetation is somewhat scattered, with the grass making way for taller trees. Shorter trees and shrubs between the grass and taller trees are somewhat uncommon. Thatched huts are also common in comparison to other southern states.
NOTE: An abundance of palms should make you lean toward the [bordering southern states](https://maps.app.goo.gl/N5KTikgLk6PNkL9X8) that can look similar.
clues.summary: Lush green grass-covered ground with reddish soil, scattered taller trees and few shrubs. Thatched huts are common. Lots of palms means a neighbouring southern state instead.

clues.title: Landscape: scattered trees, red soil, dry grass
text: Niger state is the shitcam equivalent to Benue state. It is almost entirely covered by **shitcam**, and can be recognized by the scattered trees, **reddish soil**, and **dry grass**.
clues.summary: A middle state covered almost entirely by the very low-quality camera, with scattered trees, reddish soil and dry grass. It looks like the nearby grass-and-red-soil state.

clues.title: Landscape: very open, arid, almost treeless
text: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more **open** and **arid** landscape compared to Niger state. The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may [not be trees at all](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A). These states are entirely covered by shitcam.
clues.summary: Highways in the north-west are even more open and dry than in the middle belt. Trees become rare or absent, and it is all low-quality coverage.

clues.title: Landscape: savannah with rocky hills
text: A **savannah **landscape combined with **rocky hills** can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba. The hills in the **far east and west **of this region are typically [greener](https://goo.gl/maps/Hmbqtpv3fxcGRKuLA)** **and covered in more vegetation compared to the hills toward the middle of the range.
NOTE: Around the city of Gombe, hills composed of softer, [clay-like soil](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUUBKmdGQFN75eP9) can be seen instead.
clues.summary: In the north-east: savannah with rocky hills. Hills at the far east and west are greener than those in the middle. Near one city the hills are softer, clay-like soil.

clues.title: Landscape: monolithic rock hills, weathered
text: These monolithic mountains with **exposed, weathered rock **are common in and around Abuja.
clues.summary: Huge rock mountains with exposed, weathered stone around the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: flat, sandy, palms, silver follow car
text: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and **many palms** can be seen east of Lekki. The ground is very **sandy**. Almost all of the coverage is old Generation 3, with a [silver follow car](https://www.google.com/maps/@6.4185992,4.079123,3a,15y,284.01h,83.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTrh0nQY2S9hrUGN-v1ejng!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
clues.summary: A flat, sandy, coastal area with many palms, mostly old Gen 3 coverage with a silver follow car.

clues.title: Road: lush divided highway, short median, trucks
text: The A121 can be recognized by the lush, **tropical **vegetation surrounding the **divided **highway, with a short, concrete median. Being a major highway, many vehicles, especially trucks, can be seen along it.
NOTE: The A232 heading east of Benin City is also divided, however the median is [noticeably wider](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hbkv1uPKkgqTr3hD9) than that of the A121.
clues.summary: A major highway through lush tropical plants, divided by a short concrete median, with many trucks. Another divided highway has a noticeably wider median.

clues.title: Road: divided highway, Gen 4, open arid land
text: The A3 going east of Potiskum to the Borno State border can be recognized by the Generation 4 coverage, mostly **open arid landscape**, and the highway being **divided**.
clues.summary: A divided highway in Gen 4 coverage through mostly open, dry land, heading east of one north-eastern town toward the state border.

clues.title: Soil: dark red
text: **Dark red soil** is most commonly found in and around Benin City and Enugu.
NOTE: Red-tinged soil can be found in many places. This tip refers specifically to dark red soil.
clues.summary: Dark red soil is most common in and around two southern cities. Lighter red-tinged soil appears in many places, so this means specifically dark red.

clues.title: Landscape: tallest mountains, winding green road
text: The Obudu Plateau road can be recognized by having the **tallest mountains **in Nigeria with street view coverage. The road winds up **lush, green** mountains and the coverage is slightly foggy and wet.
clues.summary: A road winding up lush green mountains, the tallest with coverage in the country, in slightly foggy, wet-looking coverage.

clues.title: Coverage: low-quality camera with blue tint
text: This variant of shitcam with a distinct **blue tint **can be found in these areas.
clues.summary: A version of the very low-quality coverage with a distinct blue tint, found only in certain areas.

clues.title: Google car: old Gen 3 follow cars, by area
text: This map shows where each **old Generation 3** follow car can be found. They are uncommon, but can still be useful to know.

NOTE: The A121 is not shown on the map as it is recognizable from other clues. This [silver Lexus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/i36WGpXJW9q2fHhh7), not shown on the map, can rarely be seen on the highway between Onitsha and Enugu.

images.caption: Five different follow cars on a map, outlined by area where each appears

clues.summary: Different old Gen 3 follow cars appear in different areas. They are uncommon but useful. A silver Lexus rarely appears on one eastern highway.

clues.title: Google car: black or wine-red SUV, no markings
text: Benin City has these two unique follow cars: a black and a wine red Toyota SUV without police markings.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: In one southern city, the follow cars are two unmarked Toyota SUVs, one black and one wine red, with no police markings.

clues.title: Landscape: dry hazy Gen 3 road, smudge on camera
text: A dry, hazy, and somewhat gloomy landscape in Generation 3 combined with sizable mountains in the distance can be found on the road heading north of Takum to Jalingo. This smudge, which gets darker further north, is also seen at the front of the camera.
NOTE: The coverage is broken on many parts of the road, so knowing where coverage exists can be helpful.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: A dry, hazy, slightly gloomy Gen 3 road with big mountains in the distance, and a smudge on the front of the camera that gets darker further north. Coverage is broken in places.
